//: Root package.json for the whole animal-picture-app project.
The project is made of separate services (api, ui), and each one has its
own package.json and package-lock.json in its own folder. That way every
service can be installed, built and put in a Docker container on its own.
This root file does not contain application code. It only:
- states which Node.js and npm versions are required ('engines'),
- holds shortcut commands ('scripts') that run a command in every
service at once. '--prefix api' means 'run this inside the api folder'.
npm run install:all   install the packages of every service
npm run build         compile every service
npm test              run the unit tests of every service
npm run test:integration  run the integration tests of every service (needs Docker)
npm run dev:api       run the API on your machine, restarting on code changes
npm run dev:ui        run the web page on your machine, reloading on code changes
See the 'Building' section in README.md for how to use it.
name: animal-picture-app
description: Microservice application that downloads random animal pictures (cats, dogs, bears), stores them in a database and shows them in a simple web page.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix api && npm ci --prefix ui
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix ui
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix ui
